name: patent-workbench-monorepo
description: Monorepo root for Patent Workbench (client + server)
author: Jhonatan Santos

scripts.client:build:electron: cross-env VITE_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npm --workspace client run build
scripts.electron:dev: npm rebuild --workspace=server && npm run i18n:generate && concurrently -k -n server,client,electron -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run server:dev" "cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=true npm run client" "electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run server:build && npm run i18n:generate && npm run client:build:electron && node scripts/prepare-native-deps.mjs && electron-rebuild -m server --force && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --publish=never
scripts.installer:build: npm run generate:favicons && npm run electron:build && "%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe" installer\patent-workbench.iss
scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:style && npm run prettier:check
scripts.start: npm rebuild && npm run i18n:generate && concurrently -k "npm run server:dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3001/status -t 60000 && npm run client"
